items.title: US chip curbs and distillation restrictions threaten Chinese model schedules
items.content_text:
Reuters reports that constrained access to overseas compute could delay Z.AI's next flagship model and lengthen Moonshot's development cycles, according to its sources. Restrictions on distillation add another obstacle.

Sources: Reuters https://www.reuters.com/world/china/us-chip-curbs-distillation-crackdown-threaten-chinese-ai-model-development-2026-11-26/
items.summary: Reuters reports that constrained access to overseas compute could delay Z.AI's next flagship model and lengthen Moonshot's development cycles, according to its sources. Restrictions on distillation add another obstacle.

items.title: Error-driven adaptation for robot world models
items.content_text:
Researchers propose a world-model method that adapts to sudden and persistent changes in robot dynamics across fast and slow timescales. The goal is to limit prediction errors that compound during open-loop rollouts.

Sources: arXiv https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15215
items.summary: Researchers propose a world-model method that adapts to sudden and persistent changes in robot dynamics across fast and slow timescales. The goal is to limit prediction errors that compound during open-loop rollouts.

items.title: CARMEN models ten physiological signals for critical care
items.content_text:
The authors introduce a cardiorespiratory foundation model pretrained on ten physiological signal types, extending beyond the ECG and optical pulse signals common in earlier work. It targets perioperative and intensive-care applications.

Sources: arXiv https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15004
items.summary: The authors introduce a cardiorespiratory foundation model pretrained on ten physiological signal types, extending beyond the ECG and optical pulse signals common in earlier work. It targets perioperative and intensive-care applications.

items.title: Failure-driven data flywheel for vision-language-action models
items.content_text:
Researchers propose generating targeted training scenarios from failures when adapting a pretrained vision-language-action model to a new robot platform. The method is aimed at teams without large deployment fleets.

Sources: arXiv https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34698
items.summary: Researchers propose generating targeted training scenarios from failures when adapting a pretrained vision-language-action model to a new robot platform. The method is aimed at teams without large deployment fleets.

items.title: Closed-loop robotic assembly of precision optical systems
items.content_text:
A proposed framework uses robotic feedback to assemble and realign free-space optical systems and recover from errors. Optical tolerances make this a demanding test of automated physical manipulation.

Sources: arXiv https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21496
items.summary: A proposed framework uses robotic feedback to assemble and realign free-space optical systems and recover from errors. Optical tolerances make this a demanding test of automated physical manipulation.

items.title: Geometric view of reward updates in inverse reinforcement learning
items.content_text:
The authors analyze inverse reinforcement learning reward updates from a geometric perspective, supplementing the conventional primal-dual optimization view. It is a theoretical contribution rather than a deployed agent system.

Sources: arXiv https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14041
items.summary: The authors analyze inverse reinforcement learning reward updates from a geometric perspective, supplementing the conventional primal-dual optimization view. It is a theoretical contribution rather than a deployed agent system.
